risky_clauses.title: Immediate Termination Without Cause or Cure & Cargo Seizure
risky_clauses.summary: Operator may terminate and seize transit goods upon 24-hour notice without cause or cure period, with zero liability for spoilage or delay.

risky_clauses.title: Uncapped Liquidated Damages for Fuel Adjustments
risky_clauses.summary: $50,000 upfront penalty plus 300% liquidated damages merely to dispute any invoice surcharge.

obligations: Globex provides multimodal freight forwarding and ambient warehousing
Schedules and demurrage allowances per Schedule B
Distributor must maintain primary cargo insurance covering all risks
reply_email_rubric: Rejects 24-hour termination and cargo seizure rights in Section 3.1
Rejects $50,000 dispute penalty and 300% liquidated damages in Section 4.1
Proposes standard commercial dispute resolution and invoice dispute escrow
